_comment: Scaffold template -- replace <project-path> with the absolute project path after scaffolding.

hooks._comment: Design-mode preamble gate. BLOCKS Write/Edit on frontend/{src,e2e/mockups}/*.tsx|html|ts when .lattice/design-mode.lock has preamble:pending. Uses git-rev-parse to resolve repo root; relative-path hook commands silently fail to fire on Windows (verified 2026-04-28 in pcc). Cooperates with scripts/design-session.sh state machine. See commands/lattice/design.md Step 0.

hooks.command: bash -c 'LOCK_DIR=".lattice/commit.lock"; if [ -d "$LOCK_DIR" ]; then LOCK_META=""; if [ -f "$LOCK_DIR/meta" ]; then LOCK_META=$(cat "$LOCK_DIR/meta"); fi; LOCK_AGE=0; if [ -f "$LOCK_DIR/meta" ]; then LOCK_TIME=$(stat -c %Y "$LOCK_DIR/meta" 2>/dev/null || stat -f %m "$LOCK_DIR/meta" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); NOW=$(date +%s); LOCK_AGE=$((NOW - LOCK_TIME)); fi; echo "BLOCKED: commit lock is held."; echo "  Holder:"; echo "$LOCK_META" | sed "s/^/    /"; echo "  Age: ${LOCK_AGE}s"; echo ""; echo "If another session is committing, wait."; echo "If the lock is orphaned (the previous holder crashed), recover with:"; echo "  bash scripts/release-lock.sh --force"; echo ""; echo "(Pre-2026-05-04 this hook silently force-cleared stale locks at 300s. Audit"; echo " CRITICAL-3/HIGH-1: that auto-clear destroyed legitimate long-running locks"; echo " -- e.g. a 6-minute peer-review pass -- and was a contributing factor to"; echo " the data-loss incident. Now: block + report, manual recovery only.)"; exit 1; fi'
hooks._comment: Commit lock. BLOCKS unconditionally if another agent holds .lattice/commit.lock. Manual recovery for orphans (no auto-clear -- HIGH-1 fix 2026-05-04).

hooks.command: bash -c 'MSG=$(cat 2>/dev/null); if echo "$MSG" | grep -qE "(feat|fix):" 2>/dev/null; then if ! echo "$MSG" | grep -q "Topic:" 2>/dev/null; then echo "REMINDER: This looks like topic work (feat:/fix:) but has no Topic: trailer."; echo "Add to commit message body:"; echo "  Topic: <topic-name>"; echo "  Phase: <phase>  (optional: research-complete, blueprint-complete, complete)"; echo ""; echo "Without Topic:, the autopilot and coherence engine cannot track this work."; echo "If this is NOT topic work (framework, docs, CI), ignore this reminder."; fi; fi'
hooks._comment: Topic trailer reminder. WARNS (non-blocking) when feat/fix commits lack a Topic: trailer.

hooks.command: bash -c 'GATE=".lattice/review-gate.json"; if [ ! -f "$GATE" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: /lattice:review was not run."; echo ""; echo "Every commit requires a review gate. No exceptions."; echo ""; echo "REQUIRED before committing:"; echo "  1. Run /lattice:review (writes the gate file when all checks pass)"; echo "  -- OR for trivial fixes (docs-only, typo, comment) --"; echo "  2. Run: bash scripts/write-review-gate.sh pass \"trivial fix\""; echo ""; exit 1; fi; GATE_TIME=$(stat -c %Y "$GATE" 2>/dev/null || stat -f %m "$GATE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); NOW=$(date +%s); GATE_AGE=$((NOW - GATE_TIME)); if [ "$GATE_AGE" -gt 1800 ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Review gate is stale (${GATE_AGE}s old, max 1800s)."; echo "Re-run /lattice:review before committing."; exit 1; fi'
hooks._comment: Review gate enforcement. BLOCKS ALL commits without a fresh review gate file.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if cat | grep -q "Co-Authored-By"; then echo "BLOCKED: CLAUDE.md rule 4 -- never add Claude as co-author."; exit 2; fi'
hooks._comment: Co-author block. BLOCKS writes containing Co-Authored-By.
